title: Cobblemon Modpack by ur_jolly
description: Cobblemon Modpack turns your Minecraft world into a Pokémon-style adventure with mechanics similar to the Pokémon games:
body:
Pokémon Capture & Training

Wild Pokémon spawn throughout your world, and you can capture them, add them to your team, and level them up. 
CurseForge

There are over 700 Pokémon from generations 1–9 available to find and catch. 
CurseForge

⚔️ Battles & Experience

Pokémon battles use a battle system based on the Pokémon Showdown! engine for competitive mechanics. 
CurseForge

Winning battles gives experience so your Pokémon can learn moves and evolve. 
CurseForge

📒 Pokédex & Scanning

A Pokédex records every Pokémon you encounter and catch, with a scanning feature to analyze wild Pokémon. 
CurseForge

🤝 Multiplayer & Interaction

You can trade and battle with friends in multiplayer worlds. 
CurseForge

🏡 Pokémon Management

Pastures let wild Pokémon roam freely. 
CurseForge

Apricorn trees grow in the world and are used in crafting. 
CurseForge

Medicine items can be brewed with crops and berries, working similarly to Minecraft’s brewing stand. 
CurseForge

🦴 World Integration & Exploration

Ancient structures and fossils appear in the world; fossils can be turned into Pokémon in a resurrection machine. 
CurseForge

Support for biome mods (like Terralith) expands spawn variety. 
CurseForge

🐎 New Updates & Extra Mechanics

Recent Cobblemon versions add even more gameplay elements: 
Cobblemon Wiki

Rideable Pokémon — select Pokémon can be mounted for faster travel. 
Cobblemon Wiki

Cooking & Food mechanics — crafting new campfire pots and foods like Poké Snacks and Aprijuice. 
Cobblemon Wiki

🧩 Add-Ons (Optional Enhancements)

There are many community mods and data packs that work with Cobblemon to expand the experience, such as: 
CurseForge
+1

Cobblemon Integrations — adds HUD tooltips, JEI/JER info, Waystones and seasonal effects. 
9Minecraft

Cobblemon Additions — replaces villages with Pokémon-themed structures. 
9Minecraft

Myths & Legends Addon — introduces special key items that trigger legendary Pokémon spawning with custom conditions. 
CurseForge
